texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]返回了！尽管伤痕累累，但却载誉而归。

从一个隐藏的门中，一名外星战士突然现身并开始同我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy]展开搏斗，直到筋疲力尽。在最后一丝力量的召唤下，[Leader.GetName]设法制服了[Leader.GetHisHer]的对手。

不到一个小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发送了一条信息：

“[Leader.GetName]将被记录在我们的史册中，作为一位伟大的战士。”
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle injured, but victorious.

From a hidden door, an alien fighter emerged and proceeded to batter our [Owner.GetEnvoy] to the point of exhaustion. Summoning a last surge of strength, [Leader.GetName] managed to subdue [Leader.GetHisHer] opponent.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"[Leader.GetName] will be entered into our annals as a great warrior."

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]迷惑地从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的太空梭返回，没有找到对手。在一个小时内，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发送了一条消息：

“你们野蛮的做法让我们感到失望。对于一个开化的文明来说，进行肉体上的战斗是非常不合适的。”
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle confused, having found no opponent. Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"Your barbaric ways disappoint us. A physical fight would be most unbecoming for a civilized culture."

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]满怀信心地从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的太空梭返回。[Leader.GetHeSheCap]在感应墙前为我们的情况辩论时，忘却了时间的概念，全面地解释了历史决策的各种原因以及我们作为一个文化如何学习和成长。

不到一个小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发来了一条消息：

“尽管你们过去经历了困难，但你们取得了巨大的成长。你们的文化是一个鼓舞人心的榜样。”
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle brimming with conviction. [Leader.GetHeSheCap] had lost track of time arguing our case in front of the sensor wall, explaining the reasons for historical decisions and how we've learned and grown as a culture.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"Despite your troubled past, you have grown spectacularly. Your culture is an inspiration."

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]失望地从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的太空梭返回。[Leader.GetHeSheCap]在感应墙前花了一个多小时，事无巨细地介绍我们的文化，并辩论我们历史决策的正确性。

不久之后，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发来了一条信息：

“你所叙述的历史展示的是你的文化的贫瘠。”
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle disappointed. [Leader.GetHeSheCap] spent over an hour at the sensor wall presenting our culture in greater detail and arguing for the rightness of our historical decisions.

Shortly thereafter, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"The history you describe paints a poor picture of your culture."

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的穿梭机上兴高采烈地回来了。描述我们过去和未来的即兴歌词自由地传唱着，这是由我们的[Owner.GetEnvoy]诗人在两者之间创造出了令人惊讶由具有启发的联系。

不到一小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发来了一条消息：

“你们的文化非常辉煌，我们对这场表演表示赞赏。”
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle in a great mood. The improvised lyrics describing our past and future had flown freely, with our [Owner.GetEnvoy]-poet making associations both surprising and illuminating.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"Your culture is most splendid and we applaud the performance."

texts.zh:
[Leader.GetName]从[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的太空梭返回，[Leader.GetHisHer]的音乐表演让自己感到很不满。我们过去的行为与我们当前的自我认知之间的不和谐使得歌词的联想变得平淡无奇。

不到一小时，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]发来了一条消息：

“我们对一次重要的思想交流会被平庸的韵律破坏感到失望。”
texts.en:
[Leader.GetName] returned from the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] shuttle dissatisfied with [Leader.GetHisHer] musical performance. The dissonance between our past actions and our current self-conception made the lyrical associations fall flat.

Within the hour, the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] sent a message:

"We are disappointed that a momentous meeting of minds was spoiled by middling rhymes."
